dialogues.jp: 「こんなところに公園があったとは……」

桜公園をぶらりと散歩していてたどり着いた公
園……。
dialogues.en:
Walking around idly around the Sakura Park, I happened upon
what seemed like a playground inside.
dialogues.text:
Walking around idly around the Sakura Park, I happened upon
what seemed like a playground inside.

dialogues.jp: 多分、見覚えはないと……思う。
dialogues.en: I don't remember seeing this... I think.
dialogues.text: I don't remember seeing this... I think.

dialogues.jp:
いや、記憶の糸を手繰れば、来たことがあるよ
うな気がしないでもないが……。
dialogues.en:
No, I have vague memories of this place, but not actually
coming here...
dialogues.text:
No, I have vague memories of this place, but not actually
coming here...

dialogues.jp: どうせ俺には用もないし。
dialogues.en: Nothing for me to do here anyway.
dialogues.text: Nothing for me to do here anyway.

dialogues.jp:
むしろ、ちらほらと姿の見える子供たちに混じっ
て遊ぶほどの勇者じゃない、というのが本音だ。
dialogues.en:
Although there's no kids around right now, I don't really
feel like playing around.
dialogues.text:
Although there's no kids around right now, I don't really
feel like playing around.

dialogues.jp:
まぁ、童心に帰りたくなった時にでも来てみよ
う……。
dialogues.en:
Well, maybe one day when I get the urge to re-live my
childhood...
dialogues.text:
Well, maybe one day when I get the urge to re-live my
childhood...

dialogues.jp: 見覚えのあるようなないような……。
dialogues.en: I don't remember it being there though...
dialogues.text: I don't remember it being there though...
